spans.s:
वैजन वैजन, अस्, m., N. of the author of
the grammatical work called Prabodha-candrikā.

वैजनन वैजनन, अम्, n. (fr. वि-जनन),
the last month of pregnancy (= प्रसव-मास).

वैजयन्त वैजयन्त, अस्, m. (fr. वि-जयन्त),
the banner or emblem of Indra; a banner, flag; the
palace of Indra; (ई), f. a flag, banner; an ensign;
a kind of garland; the necklace of Viṣṇu (com-
posed of five gems, viz. pearl, ruby, emerald, sap-
phire, and diamond); N. of the eighth night of the
civil month; the plant Sesbana Ægyptiaca; Premna
Spinosa; N. of a lexicon.

वैजयन्तिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, bearing a flag; (अस्),
m. a flag-bearer, standard-bearer; (आ), f. a flag,
banner; a kind of scarf or a string or necklace of
pearls; the plant Sesbana Ægyptiaca (= जयन्ती);
another plant (= अग्नि-मन्थ).

वैजयि वैजयि, इस्, m. (fr. वि-जया), the third
Jaina Cakra-vartin or emperor (= मघवन्).

वैजयिक वैजयिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-जय),
relating to victory, victorious.

वैजवाप वैजवाप, अस्, m. (fr. वीज-वाप),
N. of a Muni; of the author of a law-book.

वैजवापि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. वीज-वापिन्), see Gaṇa
Sutaṅgamādi to Pāṇ.

; (इस्), m. a patro-
nymic from Vīja-vāpa or Vīja-vāpin; (अयस्), m.
pl., N. of a warrior-tribe.

वैजवापीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वैजवापि), see
Gaṇa Raivatikādi to Pāṇ.

; (अस्), m. a
prince of the Vaijavāpis.

वैजात्य वैजात्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-जाति), differ-
ence of class or species or kind, difference of caste,
diversity of ordinary character or conduct, extraor-
dinariness, strangeness; exclusion from caste; loose-
ness, wantonness.

वैजिक वैजिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वीज), seminal,
relating to seed, belonging to any primary cause or
source or principle, original; relating to conception;
relating to sexual union; (अस्), m. a young shoot,
sprout, scion; (अम्), n. cause, source, origin, motive;
the spiritual cause of existence, soul, spirit; oil pre-
pared from the Śigru or Morunga.
वैजि, इस्, इस्, इ, see Gaṇa Gahādi to Pāṇ.

वैजीय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वैजि), see Gaṇa Gahādi
to Pāṇ.
वैजेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Vīja.

वैज्ञानिक वैज्ञानिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-
ज्ञान), conversant with, skilful, clever, proficient.
